concerns.text: The plan states to download a QM9 subset via `torch_geometric.datasets.QM9` (Task T010) but does not specify the size of the subset. Without a concrete molecule count, it is unclear whether the downstream preprocessing, training of two GNNs, and baseline can complete within the 6‑hour runtime and 4 GB RAM limits on a free‑tier GitHub Actions runner. Add an explicit upper bound on the number of molecules (e.g., ≤ 20 k) to guarantee CPU‑first feasibility.
